sources.forward_response_remaining_80: embedded as newly evaluated rows inside forward_response_full_100; no separate artifact

split_contract.grouping: complete episode; no episode crosses fit/selection/OOF
split_contract.oof_usage: score only; never checkpoint, threshold, epoch, seed, or hyperparameter selection

coarse_initialization.target: final observable_current_action_to_zero forward-response branch where available; fullrank absolute teacher only for the other mature snapshots
coarse_initialization.purpose: bounded finite round-0 initialization only; Actor BC cost/recovery is not an OAC admission gate

critic.inputs: the same strict observable context plus an explicit absolute candidate [8,2]
critic.target: fit-only standardized log1p frozen-Query direct J50
critic.loss: Huber absolute value plus same-state pair ranking
critic.state_balancing: sample contexts first, then candidates; the 100 landscape contexts must not dominate the other 500 mature snapshots
critic.candidate_sampling: 48 valid candidates per sampled state: exact warm index 0, the fit-state minimum, 23 uniform valid candidates, and 23 candidates balanced across fit-state log-cost quantiles; labels are used only inside fit folds
critic.target_standardization: fit-only and state-balanced: each fit context has equal weight regardless of whether it has 132 or 897 valid candidates

critic_pretrain_gates.aggregation: compute state-level metrics first, then take the median over all 600 OOF states for each pooled seed; at least 2 of 3 pooled seeds must pass every gate
critic_pretrain_gates.landscape_bank_gain_recovery_definition: over the 100 OOF landscape contexts, sum(prior_noanchor_canonical_cost - critic_selected_cost) / sum(prior_noanchor_canonical_cost - best_canonical_eligible_cost); selection and oracle exclude old-warm-shadow branch candidates

oac_pilot.type: terminal contextual bandit; no next-state, Bellman bootstrap, target network, or entropy
oac_pilot.candidate_contract: Actor center + 16 antithetic directions + six forward-response proposals
oac_pilot.actor_step_cap_semantics: cap only; never scale a naturally smaller update upward
oac_pilot.actor_objective: mean conservative max(Q1,Q2) log-cost plus output trust
oac_pilot.replay: retain every Query-evaluated candidate including regressions and clipped actions
oac_pilot.checkpoint_selection: fresh frozen-Query direct cost on the inner-selection episodes; round zero participates

warm_contract.role: external shadow comparator and future hard guard only
